text:
sam_marketing: Hey team — draft of launch post is up: https://drive.redwoodinference/launch_draft_v2.docx
priya_product: taking a pass now. Main asks: 1) confirm hero screenshot (should show dedicated dashboard with latency chart), 2) confirm sponsor mention placement.
lena_design: I uploaded two hero options in the drive. prefer hero_v2 (cleaner chart). @sam_marketing can you confirm which to use for social cards?
diego_ops: FYI, if we link the demo sign-up we need to provision two separate demo rooms (EU/US) and add UTM params so leads route to correct HubSpot pipeline. Proposal:

UTM template:
?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=private-demo&utm_region={region}

sam_marketing: makes sense. I'll annotate CTAs with region tokens. Also want to include 1-sentence sponsor blurb — legal signoff needed.
eric_legal: quick flag: sponsorship copy must be explicit about partner role and we need photo rights release for partner logo. Send partner logo assets and a brief usage statement.
sam_marketing: pinging partner for logo and release now. Also, small ask — can we soften benchmarking language? Avoid absolute claims like "50% cheaper" without afootnote.
priya_product: agreed. Replace definitive numbers with ranges and link to benchmark appendix. I'll draft the appendix.
lena_design: social card variants ready once we pick hero. Also need a square image for partner cross-post.
sam_marketing: diego — once demo rooms are provisioned can you set auto-routing in HubSpot? mapping below:
- region=US -> pipeline: Demo - US
- region=EU -> pipeline: Demo - EU
- region=APAC -> pipeline: Demo - APAC (fallsback to US if unavailable)

diego_ops: yep, will set up and add webhook to pass attendee emails + selected time slot. ETA EOD tomorrow.
pr-bot: Reminder: embargo lift proposed for 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. If legal or partner needs earlier review, say now.
eric_legal: I need partner logo + release by EOD today to clear usage. Also need the benchmark appendix with sources.
sam_marketing: partner confirmed they can send assets today. priya — appendix ETA?
priya_product: I'll have appendix draft by 2pm PT with citations and the "how we measured" paragraph.
sam_marketing: Great. After legal signoff I'll update the draft and send final for a 1-hour review window. If anyone has objections to timing, speak now :thumbsup:
lena_design: :thumbsup:
diego_ops: :thumbsup:
eric_legal: :thumbsup: pending receipt of assets
pr-bot: Noted. Scheduling final review 2026-05-01 16:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwoodinference/final-launch-review
sam_marketing: Thanks all — will follow up with updated doc and CTAs. Closing thread when final's live.
